tools.name: read
tools.description: Read file content or inspect a directory.

path.description: Path relative to cwd or an absolute path.

offset.description: Start position: a 1-based line number, or a 0-based byte offset when rangeType is bytes. Values below the start mean the beginning. Defaults to the beginning.

limit.description: Maximum lines or bytes to return. Defaults to the configured content limit.

rangeType.description: Unit used by offset and limit. Defaults to lines.

contentEncoding.description: utf8 for text, base64 for binary content. Defaults to the encoding that decodes the content.

includeContent.description: When false, return file metadata without reading file content.
